macros.name: addlines
macros.doc: The \addlines command adds enough vertical space to the current text block to fit in one more line of text. An optional argument specifies the number of lines to add; negative numbers remove space, and fractional numbers are fine, too.

macros.name: squeezepage
macros.doc: When used without an optional argument \squeezepage doesn’t add any additional space but does try to squeeze the page. \squeezepage[⟨lines⟩] adds extra space before doing so.
